full_judgment: 13. The submission of the learned Deputy Attorney-General that the petitioner being a member of a disciplined force within the meaning of Article 152 of the Constitution cannot file a writ petition is already settled in the cases reported in 31 DLR (AD) 143, 34 DLR (AD) 173 and 45 DLR 459 wherein it has been held that a writ petition filed by a member of a disciplined force will be maintainable if he was discharged from service by an order of an individual officer and not by a court or a tribunal established under a law relating to such force.
